sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Cái này có nước mắm không? is a confirmation phrase for moments when you want to avoid guessing. It lets someone correct you gently, point to the right option, or confirm that Does this contain fish sauce is right.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Use Cái này có nước mắm không? when you are almost sure but want confirmation. Hold up the option you mean, then pause for yes, no, or a correction.
